summary: Standard form writes a very big or very small number as $a \times 10^{k}$, with $1 \le a < 10$.

blocks.text: A ball that bounces loses height each time. Write the heights as a [[geometric|geometric sequence]] and add them.
Your calculator may show 5.2E30. In an answer, write $5.2 \times 10^{30}$ instead.
